All components reduce to exactly 2 packages because Torah #101 is structurally a single binary teaching: the entire argument maps onto one pair of opposed domains (אנפין נהירין / אנפין חשוכין). Every other bechina-connected node is an elaboration of one pole or the other. No eitza connections were used for grouping.

packages.label: אַנְפִּין נְהִירִין
packages.label_en: Luminous Faces — Torah Intellect and Holiness
packages.reason: The entire positive teaching of Torah #101 orbits a single concept: אנפין נהירין (luminous faces), which the Rebbe identifies as Torah knowledge, the divine intellect, and the holiness of Israel. The word 'אנפין' (Aramaic for 'faces/aspects') plus 'נהירין' (illuminated) describes what happens when a person grasps the wisdom of Torah: they attain the state of בְּחִינַת אנפין נהירין. Everything in this package is a face or expression of that same luminous-intellect reality. The three cognitive sekhel-faculties — חכמה (raw intellect/initial flash of wisdom), בינה (understanding/learning and comprehending), and דעת (knowledge/knowing Torah fully) — are three stages of the same luminous-intellect event. They are called 'ידים לתורה' (hands for receiving Torah), which are the three hands of the verse: יד הגדולה, יד החזקה, יד הרמה. The three faculties together constitute שלש פעמים י"ק = gematria of אדם, which is why 'אַתֶּם קְרוּיִין אָדָם' — it is Torah-intellect that defines a human being. Torah itself is a bechina of י"ה (the Yud-Heh of the Divine Name = chokhmah + binah), and the five books of Torah are the five articulatory positions of the mouth. חכמות התורה (the wisdom-dimensions of Torah) is the content of י"ה. תרין רעין דלא מתפרשין (the two inseparable companions — chokhmah and binah) are the same pair. מה שאדם משיג בשכלו (what a person grasps with his intellect) is directly identified as אנפין נהירין. ידיעת והשגת התורה (Torah knowledge and attainment) is named as the content of אנפין נהירין. קדשת ישראל עם קדוש (the holiness of Israel as a holy people) is declared a bechina of אנפין נהירין — because Israel's root-nature is removed from desires and bad traits. All these nodes share the same essential nature: luminous intellect, Torah comprehension, divine image (צֶלֶם אֱלֹקִים realized through knowing Torah). The good/evil mirror for this package is Package 2 (אנפין חשוכין).

merge_notes.source_edge: Edge 1146: שכל פשוט ↔ חכמה (proof: שֵׂכֶל פָּשׁוּט, שֶׁהוּא בְחִינַת חָכְמָה)
merge_notes.reason: The Torah explicitly equates שכל פשוט (primary/raw intellect) with חכמה (the first sefira of intellect). This is Stage 1 of the three-stage intellect described in Torah #101 (Section 15: 'שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת חָכְמָה, בְּחִינַת: כֻּלָּם בְּחָכְמָה עָשִׂיתָ'). חכמה is itself a face of the same luminous-intellect reality that constitutes אנפין נהירין — the Torah says 'חָכְמַת אָדָם תָּאִיר פָּנָיו', i.e., wisdom illuminates the face, which IS אנפין נהירין. Merge into Package 1.

merge_notes.source_edge: Edge 525: כשלומד ומבין ↔ בינה (proof: וּכְשֶׁלּוֹמֵד וּמֵבִין, זֶה נִקְרָא בִּינָה)
merge_notes.reason: Stage 2 of the three-stage intellect. בינה is the second faculty: when you study and understand, that act of comprehension is called בינה. The Torah (Section 15) lists it as the second of the three sekhel-faculties. בינה is itself part of י"ה (Yud-Heh = chokhmah + binah, the inseparable pair), and the entire package centers on the intellect that produces אנפין נהירין. This small component belongs with the other intellect-nodes in Package 1.

merge_notes.source_edge: Edge 759: כשיודע התורה ↔ דעת (proof: כְּשֶׁיּוֹדֵעַ הַתּוֹרָה, זֶה נִקְרָא דַּעַת)
merge_notes.reason: Stage 3 of the three-stage intellect. When one fully knows Torah — that is called דעת. The Torah (Section 15) explicitly names all three stages together: חכמה, בינה, דעת as the 'three intellectuals' that are 'three times יק = Adam'. This triplet is the backbone of the positive teaching. Merge into Package 1.

merge_notes.merged_component: Component 6 — {חמשה חמשי תורה, חמשת מוצאות הפה}
merge_notes.source_edge: Edge 1191: חמשה חמשי תורה ↔ חמשת מוצאות הפה (proof: חֲמִשָּׁה חֻמְּשֵׁי תּוֹרָה, בְחִינַת חֲמֵשֶׁת מוֹצָאוֹת הַפֶּה)
merge_notes.reason: The five books of Torah are a bechina of the five articulatory positions of the mouth (guttural, palatal, lingual, dental, labial). This bechina identifies Torah as the verbalized intellect — speech given form through mouth-positions. In Torah #101 (Section 3), the Heh of the Divine Name (הֵא הוּא אוֹתִיּוֹת שֶׁל הַתּוֹרָה, שֶׁהוּא חֲמִשָּׁה חֻמְּשֵׁי תּוֹרָה בְּחִינַת חֲמֵשֶׁת מוֹצָאוֹת הַפֶּה) — the Heh = Torah = five books = five mouth-positions. This belongs with Package 1 because Torah is the central bechina of אנפין נהירין in this teaching. The letters of Torah are the very substance of luminous-face reality.

merge_notes.merged_component: Component 7 — {שלש שכליות אלו, ידים לתורה, יד הגדולה ויד החזקה ויד הרמה}
merge_notes.source_edges: Edge 1256: שלש שכליות אלו ↔ ידים לתורה; Edge 1246: ידים לתורה ↔ יד הגדולה ויד החזקה ויד הרמה
merge_notes.reason: This 3-node chain expresses that the three intellect-stages (chokhmah, binah, daat) serve as 'hands for receiving Torah' — metaphorically the three extended hands by which Torah is grasped and held. This is an aspect of the same intellectual-receptivity domain as אנפין נהירין. The Torah (Section 15) says explicitly: 'שָׁלֹשׁ שִׂכְלִיּוּת אֵלּוּ, הֵם בְחִינַת יָדַיִם לַתּוֹרָה, בְּחִינַת יָד הַגְּדוֹלָה וְיָד הַחֲזָקָה וְיָד הָרָמָה, שֶׁבָּהֶם מִתְקַבֶּלֶת הַתּוֹרָה'. All three concepts share the nature: 'the intellect that receives Torah.' Merge into Package 1.

merge_notes.merged_component: Component 10 — {אלו השלשה שכליים, שלש פעמים י"ק}
merge_notes.source_edge: Edge 2953: אלו השלשה שכליים ↔ שלש פעמים י"ק (proof: אֵלּוּ הַשְּׁלֹשָׁה שִׂכְלִיִּים, הֵם בְחִינַת שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים י"ק... שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים י"ק הוּא גִּימַטְרִיָּא אָדָם)
merge_notes.reason: The three intellectual stages (חכמה, בינה, דעת) are equated with three repetitions of יק (Yud-Heh, the Divine Name fragment that represents intellect). Three times 26 (actually יק = 15, three times 15 = 45 = אדם in gematria). This bechina directly links the three-intellect structure to the cosmic number אדם, making it the summit of the positive teaching. It is an elaboration of the same luminous-intellect cluster. Merge into Package 1.

packages.label: אַנְפִּין חֲשׁוּכִין
packages.label_en: Dark Faces — Passions, Bad Traits, and Subjugation
packages.reason: The negative pole of Torah #101 is equally unified: everything converges on אנפין חשוכין (dark/obscured faces), which is the domain of what is not grasped by Torah-intellect. The Rebbe identifies: what one does not comprehend (מה שאינו משיג) as a bechina of אנפין חשוכין; the seventy nations (שבעים עכו"ם) as a bechina of אנפין חשוכין (because they grasp only the dark-face domains of passion and bad traits); concealment of knowledge (חשכות והסתרת הידיעה) as a bechina of אנפין חשוכין; and desires and bad traits (תאוות ומדות רעות) as a bechina of אנפין חשוכין. The burdens of exile — physical subjugation (שעבוד בגשמיות = על מלכות) and bad traits of the nations (מדות רעות של העכו"ם = על דרך ארץ) — are the concrete historical manifestation of the same dark-face domain operating in the world. They describe what falls upon someone when they abandon Torah (the 'ol Torah) and thereby come under the dominion of אנפין חשוכין. These are not separate domains but specific expressions of the same fundamental reality: the domain of passion, ignorance, and foreign domination that opposes Torah-intellect. The evil mirror for Package 2 (dark faces) is Package 1 (luminous faces) — the same spectrum of reality, aligned opposite ways. The 70 nations are the cosmic dimension of dark-faces; שעבוד and מדות רעות are the individual and national manifestations.

merge_notes.merged_component: Component 8 — {מדות רעות של העכו"ם, על דרך ארץ}
merge_notes.source_edge: Edge 2390: מדות רעות של העכו"ם ↔ על דרך ארץ (proof: הַמִּדּוֹת רָעוֹת שֶׁל הָעַכּוּ"ם, שֶׁזֶּהוּ בְחִינַת עֹל דֶּרֶךְ אֶרֶץ)
merge_notes.reason: The bad traits of the nations ARE identified as the 'yoke of earth-ways' (על דרך ארץ). The source text (Section 7) explains: 'וְגַם דֶּרֶךְ אַרְצִיּוּת, דְּהַיְנוּ הַמִּדּוֹת רָעוֹת שֶׁל הָעַכּוּ"ם, שֶׁזֶּהוּ בְּחִינַת עֹל דֶּרֶךְ אֶרֶץ'. This pair expresses the same reality as שבעים עכו"ם and תאוות ומדות רעות in Component 2 — both are faces of the dark-face domain. Merge into Package 2.

merge_notes.source_edge: Edge 2392: שעבוד בגשמיות ↔ על מלכות (proof: שִׁעְבּוּד בְּגַשְׁמִיּוּת, שֶׁזֶּהוּ בְחִינַת עֹל מַלְכוּת)
merge_notes.reason: Physical subjugation to foreign rule (שעבוד בגשמיות) is identified as the 'yoke of kingship' (על מלכות). The source text (Section 7) explains that when someone abandons the yoke of Torah (which IS אנפין נהירין), the yoke of foreign dominion (אנפין חשוכין in its political expression) takes over. שעבוד בגשמיות is the outer, political manifestation of the dark-face domain's dominion. It belongs with אנפין חשוכין, whose defining feature is the lack of Torah-intellect and the resulting grip of the nations' reality over the individual. Merge into Package 2.
